name: qr-toolkit
title: QR Code Toolkit
description: Decode QR codes from images and generate QR codes from text
author: damon_lucas

commands.name: decode
commands.title: Decode QR Code
commands.subtitle: QR Toolkit
commands.description: Read QR code content from an image file or clipboard

commands.name: generate
commands.title: Generate QR Code
commands.subtitle: QR Toolkit
commands.description: Create a QR code from text or URL

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, you can remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
